tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, code frames, previews, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs. Pair with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and around surfaces. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on canvas, surface and brand-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, descriptions, table cells on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, timestamps on canvas and surface. Never for long text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Velyx Blue. The mark, primary buttons, links, focus ring, active nav. Text-safe on canvas, surface and brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav background, inline code highlight, callouts.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter. Diff additions in docs, the CLI cursor, 'new' badges. A fill, never text; at most one per screen.

tokens.name: on-marker
tokens.usage: Text on marker fills, both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Installed, passed, copied. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only. One per page.

styles.usage: Page titles in docs and marketing.

styles.name: label

styles.usage: Default copy in docs and UI.

styles.name: code-inline
